version.description: - Updated the error reporting to better return errors to the user.

data.messageTransform: "Scheduling From Screen Input Work Order ID: " & REQUEST.DATA.workOrder.id

data.transform:
{
	"SUCCESS": false,
	"MESSAGE": $state
		.lastError
		.info
		.errors
		.extensions
		.fuuz
		.response
		.body
		.info
		.message
		? $state
			.lastError
			.info
			.errors
			.extensions
			.fuuz
			.response
			.body
			.info
			.message
		: "An unexpected error occured. See logs for details"
}
